name: github
description: Read GitHub issues and feature roadmaps (Projects) via GitHub's official hosted MCP server. Read-only HTTP endpoint, browser OAuth.

connection.instructions:
Connect by signing in to GitHub in your browser, then authorise read access to the repositories and Projects you want to surface.

GitHub does not support dynamic client registration, so a myHub administrator must first register a GitHub OAuth App (or GitHub App) and configure its client ID and secret in myHub — see the plugin README. Once that's in place, each user authorises individually and the server only sees data that user can already access on GitHub.
